### The Philosophy: A Lean Activation Team

This document outlines the structure of the temporary "activation team", the small, core group of strategic leaders required to bootstrap a decentralized institutes of health (DIH) network. Our goal is not to build a large, permanent organization. It is to assemble an elite team whose sole function is to build a self-sustaining protocol and then make themselves obsolete.

To achieve this, we distinguish between core strategic functions and tactical execution:

- **Core Functions (Internal Team):** Strategy, leadership, political maneuvering, legal architecture, and product vision are handled by the small, core team. This is the permanent brain trust.
- **Tactical Execution (Outsourced):** Functions like software development, specialized quantitative analysis, and media production will be outsourced to world-class agencies and contractors. This provides flexibility and access to elite talent without building a large, permanent bureaucracy.

Our strategy is to build a lean, world-class core team for direct execution and to aggressively leverage contractors, prize-based competitions, and partner organizations to scale our impact without a large, bureaucratic overhead.

![A hub-and-spoke visualization illustrating the lean internal core team managing a flexible network of outsourced execution partners.](/assets/images/hiring-plan/hiring-plan-section-operating-model-diagram-bw-academic.jpg)


### Compensation Philosophy

All core team members will receive modest, market-rate cash salaries combined with large, vested grants of VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bonds. This approach preserves cash for high-leverage political and technical spending while deeply aligning the team's long-term financial success with the success of the mission.

![A visual breakdown of the compensation structure showing how a mix of cash salaries and vested bond grants balances immediate operational spending with long-term mission alignment.](/assets/images/hiring-plan/hiring-plan-section-compensation-philosophy-bw-academic.jpg)


### Phase 1: Seed (Core Team Headcount: ~20)

This initial phase focuses on establishing the leadership, legal, and technical foundation required to build the framework and prove the political model in pilot regions.

![A visual breakdown of Phase 1 showing the three foundational pillars, leadership, legal, and technical, supporting the core objectives of framework development and pilot testing.](/assets/images/hiring-plan/hiring-plan-section-phase-1-seed-core-team-headcount-20-bw-academic.jpg)


#### Leadership & Operations (5 Roles)

- **Chief Executive Officer:** Overall project lead, responsible for strategy, fundraising, and external relations.
- **Chief Operating Officer:** Manages internal operations, budget, and cross-departmental execution.
- **Chief Technology Officer:** Leads the technical strategy and development of the referendum platform and the 1% Treaty Fund.
- **Chief Strategy Officer:** Owns the political, economic, and game-theoretic strategy.
- **General Counsel:** Manages the global legal strategy, including election law, securities compliance, and treaty frameworks.

![Organizational chart illustrating the five core leadership roles and their primary areas of responsibility within the project's executive structure.](/assets/images/hiring-plan/hiring-plan-section-leadership-operations-5-roles-bw-academic.jpg)


##### Product, Design, & Community (3 Roles)

- **Head of Product:** Defines the product strategy, roadmap, and user experience for the global referendum platform.
- **Head of Design:** Leads the user experience (UX) and interface (UI) design to ensure the framework is accessible, trustworthy, and easy to use for a global audience.
- **Head of Community:** Builds and manages the global community of supporters, voters, and partners across all platforms.

###### Political & Growth (4 Roles)

- **Head of Political Strategy:** Executes the global campaign strategy, managing all independent expenditure and lobbying efforts.
- **Elections IE Compliance Lead:** Ensures all political spending and activities are fully compliant in every jurisdiction.
- **Growth and Referrals Lead:** Designs and manages the incentive programs for the global referendum.
- **Communications Director:** Manages messaging, media relations, and public narrative.

###### Platform & Technology (7 Roles)

- **Head of Platform Engineering:** Manages the day-to-day development of all technical systems.
- **AI Engineer (x2):** Develops the AI-powered fraud detection and safety oracle systems.
- **Lead Security Engineer:** Responsible for the end-to-end security of the framework and treasury.
- **Senior Backend Engineer (x2):** Builds the core infrastructure for the referendum platform.
- **Senior Frontend Engineer:** Builds the user-facing interfaces for the framework.

![An organizational diagram showcasing the technical team structure, highlighting the distribution of roles across platform leadership, AI development, security, and core engineering.](/assets/images/hiring-plan/hiring-plan-section-platform-technology-7-roles-bw-academic.jpg)


###### Finance & Economics (4 Roles)

- **Capital Markets Lead:** Structures all fundraising instruments, including the VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bond offerings.
- **Peace Dividend Analytics Lead:** Owns the economic models that quantify the value of the peace dividend.
- **Quantitative Analyst (x2):** Supports the capital markets and analytics leads.

### Phase 2: Series A (Scaled Team Headcount: ~50)

This phase focuses on scaling the political operation to all G7 nations and expanding the framework to handle the {{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} global participation threshold.

![A visualization showing the expansion of operations across G7 nations and a progress meter toward the 3.5% global participation threshold.](/assets/images/hiring-plan/hiring-plan-section-phase-2-series-a-scaled-team-headcount-50-bw-academic.jpg)


#### New Roles to be Hired

- **Regional Campaign Directors (x3):** Manages all in-country political operations for North America, Europe, and Asia.
- **Head of Security:** A senior leader to oversee all aspects of physical, cyber, and operational security.
- **Security Audit Lead (x2):** Manages the continuous, independent auditing of all smart contracts and systems.
- **Data Scientist (x3):** Analyzes referendum data and campaign effectiveness to optimize spending.
- **Additional Engineering Staff (+15-20):** Scaling the team with more backend, frontend, and infrastructure engineers to support 300M+ users.
- **Additional Political & Comms Staff (+5-10):** Hires include a Press Secretary, Digital Director, and regional field organizers.

![Organizational chart visualizing the planned team expansion across functional departments including Security, Engineering, Data Science, and Political Operations.](/assets/images/hiring-plan/hiring-plan-section-new-roles-to-be-hired-bw-academic.jpg)


### Phase 3: Growth (Full Team Headcount: ~75-100)

The final phase involves building out the full organizational structure required to manage the operational 1% Treaty Fund and ensure global compliance. This phase also marks a transition from a traditional startup structure to a more decentralized operational model.

![A diagram illustrating the transition from a centralized startup structure to a decentralized organizational model during the Growth phase, highlighting the new compliance and fund management departments.](/assets/images/hiring-plan/hiring-plan-section-phase-3-growth-full-team-headcount-75-100-bw-academic.jpg)


#### New Roles to be Hired

- **Chief Financial Officer:** Manages the multi-billion dollar 1% Treaty Fund, financial reporting, and audits.
- **Chief Compliance Officer:** Oversees the complex regulatory landscape of a decentralized institutes of health network's global operations.
- **Head of Governance / DAO Facilitator:** Manages the decentralized governance process for the 1% Treaty Fund, ensuring token holders can effectively participate in decision-making.
- **Treasury Operations Team (+10-15):** A dedicated team to manage the day-to-day operations of the 1% Treaty Fund, including grant disbursements and risk management.
- **Program Officers (+5-10):** Manages the specialized funding pools (e.g., for mental health, pragmatic cancer trials) and liaises with institutional partners.
- **HR & Administrative Staff (+5):** Building out the internal support functions for a global organization.

![Roadmap showing the trajectory of headcount growth alongside the primary strategic focus for each phase.](/assets/images/hiring-plan/hiring-plan-section-team-scaling-roadmap-bw-academic.jpg)
